title: The canonical constant-ring scalar and geometric pullback cube
statement: For arbitrary commutative rings A,B, φ:A→B and a chosen Cartesian square (h,f′,f,g), use the canonical scalar functors S and isomorphisms λ [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Let θ_R be the pullback-square comparison defining the ambient constant-ring exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. As natural transformations S_Y⋙g_B*⋙f′_B*→f_A*⋙h_A*⋙S_X′, whiskerLeft S_Y θ_B.hom followed by whiskerRight λ_f.hom h_B* and whiskerLeft f_A* λ_h.hom equals whiskerRight λ_g.hom f′_B* followed by whiskerLeft g_A* λ_f′.hom and whiskerRight θ_A.hom S_X′. There are no finiteness or flatness assumptions.

proof.text: Specialize normalized derived composition to the actual constant ring sheaves and the section-normalized StrictTower.moduleRComp. The constant coefficient isomorphisms are definitionally the published constant comparisons. The theorem identifies the transported canonical compositor with the localization of StrictTower.moduleGComp.

Paste the two compositors around the square. The equality transports agree because all proofs of the same equality agree. Functoriality of exact localization and its square-isomorphism definition identify the actual ambient pullback-square comparison with mapDerivedCategorySquareIso(moduleSquareG).

Apply the arbitrary-square tensor comparison theorem. Its two composites are the inverses of the two required composites of isomorphisms. Equality of inverses implies equality of forward maps; component extensionality gives equality of natural transformations.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleConstantScalarPullback_cube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {h : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare h f' f g) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (ProEtale.directImageScalarExtension φ Y)
        (ProEtale.directImageConstantPullbackIso B sq).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (ProEtale.directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f).hom
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B h) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f)
        (ProEtale.directImageScalarPullbackIso φ h).hom =
    Functor.whiskerRight (ProEtale.directImageScalarPullbackIso φ g).hom
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B f') ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A g)
        (ProEtale.directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f').hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (ProEtale.directImageConstantPullbackIso A sq).hom
        (ProEtale.directImageScalarExtension φ X')
